name: kanbanzai-board
description: Your Kanbanzai board in an editor tab: the cards your Claude Code and OpenCode sessions work on, which session holds each one and when one is waiting for you. The board tab is read-only.

kanbanzai.command.description: The kanbanzai command to run: an absolute path, or empty for the command bundled in this extension, else the copy in the per-user folder, else kanbanzai on PATH.

enumDescriptions: An operating-system notification when a session asks you, or a card becomes blocked, waits on you or is interrupted, while this window is not focused.
Only when a session asks you.
No operating-system notifications. The Board tab's toasts and the in-window message are not affected.
kanbanzai.notifications.description: Raise an operating-system notification (notify-send on Linux, osascript on macOS, a PowerShell toast on Windows) only while this window is not focused. In a remote window, or when the notifier is missing, only the in-window message appears.

kanbanzai.pluginSource.description: A path to a Kanbanzai checkout, used as the plugin source instead of the GitHub marketplace source when Kanbanzai: Init plans the plugin settings. For pre-release testing; leave empty otherwise.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The board and the setup run the kanbanzai command in the workspace.
